name: augur
description: Augur — build/deploy platform composing the Go Vocal design system + workspace into a private static site.

scripts.deploy: set -a && . ./.env.deploy && set +a && node build.js && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name govocal-prototypes --branch main
scripts.deploy:realtime: set -a && . ./.env.deploy && set +a && cd realtime && npx wrangler deploy
